# Pirate Arcade

Pirate Arcade is a pirate-themed arcade game collection by Erich Donahue. It includes desktop Python/Pygame games, browser ports built with Pygbag/WebAssembly, and a public build log documenting a zero-cost AI-assisted development experiment.

## Main pages

- Home: https://pirate-arcade.com/
- Play: https://pirate-arcade.com/play/
- Build Log: https://pirate-arcade.com/build-log/
- About: https://pirate-arcade.com/about/
- Source: https://pirate-arcade.com/source/

## Games

- Cannonball Clash: naval Pong-style duel, playable in browser at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/cannonball-clash/
- Treasure Cove: pirate Breakout-style brick breaker, playable in browser at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/treasure-cove/
- Kraken's Wake: pirate Asteroids-style game, playable in browser at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/krakens-wake/
- Race to Treasure Island: top-down pirate ship racer, playable in browser at https://pirate-arcade.com/play/race-to-treasure-island/
- Port Royale Tycoon: pirate property-trading desktop game.
